newsitem.title: ROMANIA: EU WELCOMES ROMANIA-HUNGARY FRIENDSHIP TREATY.
newsitem.headline: EU WELCOMES ROMANIA-HUNGARY FRIENDSHIP TREATY.

text.p: The European Union on Monday joined the United States and Britain in welcoming Romania and Hungary's agreement on the text of a long-delayed friendship treaty, which it said would reinforce stability in the area.

"The European Union considers the conclusion of the treaty will reinforce stability and the principles of good neighbourliness in Central Europe and...contribute to the process of European integration," said a statement issued by the Dutch embassy on behalf of the Irish presidency of the EU.
The treaty, unexpectedly agreed in August, is expected to end years of disputes over the status of the 1.6 million ethnic Hungarians living in Romania's central region of Transylvania.
The treaty, vital for both countries ambitions to join the European Union and NATO, is due to be signed later this month.
"(The) EU looks forward to the early signature and ratification," the statement said.
